photos.file: A chital doe (Axis axis) nabbed by a burmese python (Python bivittatus) at Pilibhit tiger reserve.jpg
photos.desc: A chital doe nabbed by a Burmese Python. The snake caught it at the hind leg and then strangulated it on the neck. Once caught, its hard for a prey to escape python's strong grab.
